claims.claim_text: The indexed John L. Caskey is a high-confidence match to archaeologist and OSS officer John 'Jack' Langdon Caskey.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: CIA identifies the full and familiar names and his OSS Izmir role; a contemporary OSS report names Major John L. Caskey; Cincinnati supplies matching prewar institutional chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from three mutually reinforcing sources: exact indexed name in a contemporary OSS report, full-name OSS identification by CIA, and matching Jack L. Caskey prewar chronology at Cincinnati.
claims.temporal_assessment: The institutional source dates Cincinnati work through 1943 and active duty beginning in 1943; CIA and the OSS report document wartime OSS service in Izmir.
claims.match_notes: No service number or personnel-file image was available for direct comparison, so the match remains high-confidence rather than confirmed. The source index's shorter form remains the indexed name.

claims.temporal_assessment: Explicitly date-bounded through 1943, when the same institutional history says Caskey was called to active duty.
